name: zeffect_handle_emitter_stop_event
description: zEffect::HandleEmitterStopEvent resolves an animation entry by cached index or name and moves active entries into stopping states.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native emitter-stop event tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x45c240 validates entry-name lookup when the cache is not positive, positive-index gate, state 2 to 6 transition, non-2/non-5 to 4 transition, state 5 preservation, zero-index skip, and return 2.
The native emitter-stop smoke verifies name lookup, cached-index path, active/stopping/frozen state transitions, and zero-index skip.
